s05086.summary: The Golden Goblin crew hustles through a rush while Sam the goblin snipes
Mrs. K phones in to criticize the pickles and Mo's slow chopping
Sam warns the oil is too hot; Big Dave waves him off
The fryer bursts into flame and Big Dave foams the whole kitchen
Foam-covered Sam says I told you as the customers cheer

s05089.summary: Lin sets up a video calling the park fountain haunted for views
Kofi notices the chess players vanished, leaving their game standing
The video keeps stopping and the dry fountain drips
Lin sees a figure in the fountain only on screen; Kofi denies it
Lin shuts off the phone and they leave without looking back

s05090.summary: Gordon frets over his clinic form, unsure about his home sample
Rosalind calls asking about the jar; Gordon sees his trunk open
A strange unblinking woman watches as Dr. Halloran spots the open trunk
The woman opens her coat to reveal the cooler bag strapped on
Gordon lunges for the bag and all three crash into pamphlets
Bev reveals she's Rosalind's sister; Tess asks who's paying

s05091.summary: Juno waits alone backstage as a hooded figure stands behind her
Juno senses the hoodie guy as a strange voice crackles in her headset
The crowd falls silent; Dev rushes in, telling Juno to walk to him
Twins whisper we found you, standing still and not breathing
Blackout; when lights return the pit is empty and player four joins

s05092.summary: Childless Margaret returns to Dr. Whitcombe hoping for a new idea
Edmund demands answers; Whitcombe says the wife has no fault
Margaret says the fault isn't hers and Edmund bristles
Sister Brigid brings lab results and blocks Edmund from grabbing them
Edmund turns on Margaret, raging about six years of waiting
Whitcombe declares the infertility is Edmund's; Edmund calls it a lie
Margaret condemns his blame and Edmund knocks the tray to the floor
Sister Brigid orders Edmund out, and he leaves
Whitcombe and Brigid gently care for Margaret with sweet tea

s05095.summary: Sage slides into Tobias's booth and mocks his username
Sage lays out suspects in the casserole theft; Tobias eyes the waitress
Linda found the dish in her oven; Sage makes Tobias pay

s05096_0.summary: At the reception, Vic presses Nora about the will
A caller warns Nora; Vic heads for the study and bolts

s05096_1.summary: A door slams in the hallway

s05097_0.summary: Darnell, eleven years inside, waits stiffly in the parole office
Officer Cruz calls Darnell back to her office

s05097_1.summary: Cruz checks on Darnell's halfway house as Gideon pretends to type
A ticking in the ceiling unsettles Darnell; Cruz blames the pipes
Gideon verifies Darnell's job and sneers at his politeness
Marisol reports a clean drug screen and lingers curiously
Darnell admits he counted ceiling tiles for eleven years
Darnell thanks Cruz for treating him like a person, and leaves
One more tick sounds; Gideon blames the pipes

s05098.summary: Teo coaches Alex on lifting as Keiko announces an audit rush
Alex drops a fragile box and something inside cracks
Keiko softens and sends them both home for the night
Teo assures tearful Alex nobody's fired; they'll buy the lamp

s05099_0.summary: Nurses Karina and Kari bicker over their confusingly similar names
Nervous Dev and Mira arrive; his mother texts that she's praying
The couple waits for hours while the nurses squabble over a chart
Dr. Fontaine calls them; Dev and Mira admit fear and walk in

A courier rushes in with a cooler addressed to the Anands
Dev grabs the cooler as Karina and Kari collide reaching for it
Dr. Fontaine halts the scrum with a dry rugby joke
The cooler holds flowers from Ma, who already knows the news

s05100.summary: Lena arrives late from trauma and banters with Okafor at the bar
Priya calls about a coding patient; Okafor tells Lena to go
Webb bursts in with evidence tying Okafor's ring to the Delacroix scene

s05101.summary: Kim tries to keep Kip's documentary camera off her client
Kim praises Jen's record but reveals Mo wants to be on her housing
Jen declares she loves Mo, the first truth she's said there
Kim has Jen sign and agrees to overlook the violation

s05104.summary: Jamal drives four kids home from a party at two a.m.
Ruben and Bianca mock Cole's drunken confession at Tasha's
Heartbroken Mika asks to be dropped first so no one sees her cry
Cole hopes he's the one; Shay says Mika means someone else

s05106.summary: Boz ribs Cal about his perpetual three-week fitness restart
Cal, Boz and Pat speculate about the silent woman with the doctor bag
Ines returns Cal's pills and notes his double dose tremor
Cal insists he's fine; Ines leaves and Boz tells him to sit

s05107.summary: Sam frets over a valuable clock in the rattling moving van
A pothole jolts the van; Sam grabs the clock
Stowaway Mrs. K emerges, refusing to leave Henry's clock
Dispatch calls about the missing client; Jen confirms she's aboard
The van screeches to a halt and Sam barely catches the clock
A rainbow appears; Mrs. K remembers Henry and Sam understands

s05108.summary: Officer Bell reminds disgraced surgeon Wendell of his strict terms
Wendell begs to treat a dying man after eleven years of compliance
Bell quietly steps out, letting Wendell go unseen

s05110.summary: A busy afternoon at the nail salon with Big Dave's first pedicure
Tasha notices Lily sweating and shaking and asks if she's okay
Lily turns grey and the shop panics, calling for help
Tasha takes charge, clashing with Mrs. K as polish shatters
Lily starts breathing again as sirens approach

s05112.summary: Donna records an overly cheerful culture review statement
Donna exposes Marcy and Marty's misdirected invoices
Donna lists absurd complaints about mandatory fun and synergy
Donna reveals nine years unseen and picks her own ugly green
Realizing the lobby is watching, Donna cheerfully ends the call

s05113.summary: Attorney Marguerite demands access to the patient in 412
Ozzie says 412 died at ten, yet the signature is fresh
412's light chimes and Dr. Hale steps out saying he's resting
Lights flicker and the sleeping visitor vanishes, chair still rocking

s05114.summary: Pam does Lou's nails in a cold, rainy salon
Lou hears something beneath the dripping; a scraping comes from the back
Soaked Gus arrives asking for the owner and decides to wait
The jets turn on by themselves as Gus sits, grinning

s05115.summary: Weary Detective Weems enters the open door of room 714
Claire bursts out of the stairwell with the bellhop's account
A text warns Claire about Weems; she refuses to show him
Ricky appears with blood on his hand, begging Weems to come
Weems admits he suspected Claire and gives chase with Ricky
In darkness, a tall woman with a violin case appears in 714

s05116.summary: Ines counts pills on a costumed heritage-week night shift
Wally arrives in a moth-eaten top hat and banters with Ines
Ines hands over Mr. Alder's chart and keeps recounting pills
Wally guesses she knows him; Ines reveals Alder once saved her
Ines goes into Room 9 alone as the monitor quickens

s05117.summary: Jo locks up hastily and pales at a text
Ray blocks Jo and the alarm sounds; he demands what she took
Bea runs out with frozen embryos; she and Jo appeal to Ray
Director Vic unlocks the door and orders nobody to move
Jo grabs the canister, Bea shoves Ray, and they bolt

s05119.summary: On a packed train, Pip whispers to Zed hidden in her backpack
Mom's texts pile up and Pip's phone dies
Mabel notes the loud bag and doubts Pip's toy story
In darkness Zed emerges and greets Mabel, who already knows him

s05120.summary: Cal gently tends a sleeping hound in his rainy clinic
Cole slips in; Cal offers coffee he refuses
Cole recalls saving a mare together and Cal's tears
Cole eyes the heavy saddle bag; Cal calls it feed money
The marshal phones warning Cole is coming; Cal says he's here
Hands on weapons, Cal reveals Cole shot the hound he saved
The hound growls; Cal hints at the weapon under his counter
Cole backs down; Cal makes him leave the pouch
Cole leaves; Cal's hidden hand holds only dog biscuits
